description: This file contains a script for reloading and updating various document types and templates related to GST and tax configurations in an ERP system, specifically for India. It includes functions to reload documents, check database columns, and update tax-related templates based on GST account data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to reload documents and update tax templates based on GST accounts for companies in India.

methods.name: get_formatted_data
methods.description: Helper function to generate conditional SQL snippets for tax templates based on account groupings and GST account data.
